registrationForm.title: Register to Join Plan
registrationForm.subtitle: Fill in information to register for the procurement plan

validation.registeredArea: Please enter a valid registered area.
validation.estimatedYield: Please enter a valid estimated yield.
validation.wantedPrice: Please enter a valid desired price.
validation.wantedPriceTooLow: Desired price must be at least {{minPrice}} VND/kg.
validation.wantedPriceTooHigh: Desired price must not exceed {{maxPrice}} VND/kg.
validation.expectedHarvestStart: Please select an expected harvest start date.
validation.expectedHarvestEnd: Please select an expected harvest end date.
validation.harvestEndAfterStart: End date must be after start date.
validation.harvestStartInThePast: Start date must not be in the past.

messages.maxRegistrationsReached: You have reached the maximum number of registrations ({{count}} applications).
messages.priceRangeHint: Desired price must be within this range to be accepted
messages.loginRequired: Please log in to submit registration.
messages.farmerOnly: Only farmers can register to join plans.
messages.noCropsAvailable: No crops available. Please add crops before registering.

step1.title: Select Plan Detail
step1.description: Select the plan detail you want to register to sell.

step2.title: Enter Crop
step2.description: If you do not have a crop area, please go to the crop area section to create a new crop area.

step3.title: Registering Area
step3.description: This is the information about the cultivation area for the plan detail you are registering. The registered area can be equal to or less than the available area of your crop. The unit is hectare (ha).

step4.title: Enter Detail Information
step4.description: Fill in complete information about yield, price and harvest time

step5.title: Submit Registration
step5.description: Review the information and submit registration for business review

importantNotes.title: Important Notes
items: Only farmers can register to join plans
Registration information will be reviewed by businesses

contactInfo.title: Contact Information
contactInfo.description: If you encounter issues or need support, please contact us.

search.title: Search
search.placeholder: Search by registration code or note...

approve.title: Confirm Approve Registration Detail
approve.description: Are you sure you want to approve this {{coffeeType}} registration detail? After approval, the farmer will be notified and you can proceed with next steps. You can create a commitment with them to unlock the crop season reporting feature for farmers.

reject.title: Reject Registration Detail
reject.description: Are you sure you want to reject this {{coffeeType}} registration detail? After rejection, you cannot approve this detail again, other details of this registration will not be affected by this action.
